1. **Read door — typed sessions (ADR-0070):** ✅ substantially done. `open_interest`, `ObservedProjection`, `ReducedSource` are now crate-private; raw feed/interest C ABI deleted; home feed is an ordinary typed session. Milestones NS-M1 and NS-M3 closed clean. [...] - **register_defaults() is dead as a production path (ADR-0069).** Replaced everywhere by explicit builder composition. Ratchet in CI.

- **Typed read sessions (ADR-0070) are the sole app-facing read API.** `open_interest`, `ObservedProjection`, `ReducedSource` — all made crate-private or removed from app docs. Old C ABI feed symbols deleted.
